mapper.select: SELECT id, program_name AS title, COALESCE(description_html, program_name) AS content, 1 - (embed_vector <=> CAST(#{vectorLiteral} AS vector)) AS score FROM policy_program WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND embed_vector IS NOT NULL AND (application_end IS NULL OR application_end >= now()) ORDER BY embed_vector <=> CAST(#{vectorLiteral} AS vector) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
